paper_title: Before Generation, Align it! A Novel and Effective Strategy for   Mitigating Hallucinations in Text-to-SQL Generation
caption: Results of different schema linking modules on BIRD-dev.
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the results of different schema linking modules on the BIRD-dev benchmark by plotting three evaluation metrics (Recall, Precision, and F1 Score) for three configurations: DIN-SQL (zero-shot), TA-SQL (zero-shot), and DIN-SQL (few-shot). The horizontal axis contains the metric categories in left-to-right order “Recall,” “Precision,” and “F1 Score,” while the vertical axis is an unlabeled numeric scale shown with evenly spaced tick marks at 40, 60, 80, and 100 (linear scale), with bar heights and value labels indicating scores within this range. Each metric forms a grouped cluster of three vertical bars: DIN-SQL (zero-shot) is shown in light blue, TA-SQL (zero-shot) in darker blue, and DIN-SQL (few-shot) in light green; in the Recall group the bars are labeled 63.58 (light blue), 71.90 (dark blue), and 72.29 (light green); in the Precision group they are 88.89 (light blue), 91.24 (dark blue), and 92.31 (light green); and in the F1 Score group they are 75.34 (light blue), 80.40 (dark blue), and 81.08 (light green). The bars are not presented as sorted by value; they are arranged consistently by legend order within each metric cluster, and no bars appear uniquely emphasized beyond the use of distinct colors and numeric annotations above each bar.
